title: 3 Years Ago, Crunchyroll’s Critically Acclaimed Action Anime Ended & Fans Still Need a Sequel
content: There’s no doubt Crunchyroll is the biggest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe. This is all the more reason that most of the major anime land on the platform. Bungo Stray Dogs is one such beloved series that fans from several regions across the globe can stream on the platform.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Game Streams Opening Cinematic
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming a 16-minute opening cinematic trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve , the newest game in its Ace Combat modern air combat franchise , on Thursday. The game will launch on October 2 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

title: Dentsu Enters Partnership with Kodansha
content: Variety reported on Friday that major Japanese advertising firm Dentsu is entering a partnership with Kodansha Ltd. that will give potential clients in North and South America access to several Kodansha intellectual properties (IPs) including Attack on Titan , Ghost in the Shell , and Blue Lock .

title: One Piece Anime's First 325 Episodes Stream on Crunchyroll in India
content: Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll will stream the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on October 20.
